name: spline-curve
title: Spline through control values
summary: A smooth curve sampled from spline(@points, t) that passes through eight control values drawn as dots, beside a closed blob whose radius follows splineLoop over a second array.
prompt: Draw a smooth curve through eight data values with the data points marked as dots, plus an organic blob shape.
teaches: Interpolate a float array smoothly with spline(@points, t), t from 0 to 1 across all values
Plot the spline as a path with pathExpression and mark the control values with arrayGet in a loop at x = i / (n − 1)
Make a closed organic shape from splineLoop as a polar radius, with pathExpression flags 1 (loop)

Fit a drawing authored at the header size to any box: a variable s = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H), a translate by half the extra space and a scale by s about the design's centre; the background drawRect runs before it, to componentWidth() × componentHeight()
pitfalls: splineLoop only wraps t into 0..1 and evaluates the ordinary spline: repeat the first value at the end of the array or the loop has a jump at the seam
spline(@a, t) spreads the n values evenly over t = 0..1, so value i sits at t = i / (n − 1); place the marker dots at the same x or they miss the curve

Canvas coordinates are pixels of the box the host gives the document, not of the header: a background drawRect to the literal header size leaves the rest of a bigger box unpainted, and literal positions get cut off in a smaller one

snippets.note: a dot at each control value: arrayGet(@points, i) at x = 20 + i * 200 / 7
points (8 values) and blob (first value repeated last)

check.describe: The blue curve passes exactly through all eight white dots with no corners; the violet blob is closed and smooth. Resized, the background fills the box and the drawing scales uniformly to fit, centred.
